description: Requires techjobs.vn sign-in. Saves your evaluation of one job against the user's CV. techjobs.vn derives the verdict (4.0+ apply, 3.0-3.9 consider, below 3.0 or a dealbreaker skip) and the confidence from the evidence (the score is rounded to one decimal first, so 2.95 counts as 3.0). One evaluation per job: saving again replaces it. Read back with list_job_evaluations.

application_id.description: Apply Tracker entry id from list_applications, for a job the user added by hand (or one that closed).

dealbreaker.description: The user's dealbreaker this job hits, if any; it forces skip.

dimensions.description: One per block; a block left out counts as unknown.

evidence.description: supported: from the JD or CV; partial: partly inferred; unknown: no data (score 3).

job_id.description: Job id from search_jobs or get_job.

score.description: Your overall 1-5 judgment (one decimal); not an average of the blocks.

name: save_job_evaluation
title: Save a job evaluation
